subject: Training exclusion — operational verification & subprocessor routing
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@covantahealth.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Covanta Health Legal <legal@covantahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: No-training commitment and operational evidence request

Hi David,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team is excited about Redwood as a serving layer. Before we move forward with procurement, our security and legal teams need an operational verification packet tied to the proposed DPA changes. Specifically we need:

- A clear statement that Covanta data will not be used for model training or model improvement (no-train) and where that commitment is reflected in the contract.
- Inventory of subprocessors that will see processed request data (not just the storage layer) and confirmation of geographic routing options.
- Evidence that any KMS or key escrow options for onshore residency can be enabled for our account.
- A sample of service-level commitments for exporting logs and audit evidence in the event of an audit.

We'd like to receive the evidence package within two weeks (target: 2025-07-22). If you have a checklist or a short mutual action plan we can put in the SOW, that would help speed up approvals.

Appreciate a concise owner and timeline so I can update procurement.

Best,
Ellen
Ellen Park
Head of Security Programs
Covanta Health

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@covantahealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jul 2025 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: No-training commitment and operational evidence request

Hi Ellen — thanks for the clear list and for the timeline. We can absolutely support a no-train commitment for Covanta and provide an operational evidence packet. High level plan and owners: 

- Contract language: legal will provide a DPA addendum with an explicit "no-training" clause and a mapped list of permitted derivative uses. Owner: Kimberly Park (legal operations). Target: redline by 2025-07-14.
- Subprocessor inventory + routing: operations will export our current subprocessor list and a zoning map showing optional onshore-only routing. Owner: Marissa Cole (platform ops). Target: evidence bundle by 2025-07-18.
- KMS residency/escrow options: we can confirm KMS residency and provide a configuration guide for on-prem or U.S.-only KMS. Owner: Marissa. Target: 2025-07-18.
- Audit artifacts: we will include an exportable audit-log sample, a retention policy excerpt, and an evidence checklist for SOC/SLA queries. Owner: David (security liaison). Target: 2025-07-18.

I'm attaching a short checklist to structure the evidence bundle (no_train_evidence_checklist.xlsx). For contract workflow we can push a DocuSign envelope once legal sends the DPA addendum.

Proposed next step: bake this into a one-page Mutual Action Plan with milestones and owners; I'll send that by end of day. Let me know if Covanta needs additional items (e.g., export-only SFTP path, automated proof of deletion reports).

Thanks,
David
Director, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

(attachment: no_train_evidence_checklist.xlsx)

Subject: Internal: Covanta evidence items and quick ops asks

Kimberly / Marissa — looping you in to scope the artifacts Ellen requested. Summary below and a couple of direct asks so we hit Covanta's 7/22 target.

What Covanta asked for: 
1) Contract language reflecting a no-training/no-model-improvement commitment.
2) Subprocessor inventory with a callout of any components that touch transient inference traffic (e.g., telemetry, tracing, logging, third-party tracing pipelines).
3) Demonstrable routing controls: confirm onshore-only path, SFTP export lane, and whether we can add an IP allowlist for export endpoints.
4) Proof of KMS residency options and key management configuration examples for U.S.-only keys.
5) Sample audit exports and a brief guide on running an ad-hoc evidence pull.

Immediate asks for you both: 
- Marissa: can you produce a timeboxed export (csv) of current subprocessors and an architecture sketch that highlights where transient inference data could be visible? Also confirm whether our onshore routing toggle is available per-account or only per-cluster.
- Kimberly: please draft the DPA addendum paragraph(s) language we should propose (one paragraph that states no-training + a short definition of "derivative uses"). Also flag any downstream subprocessor contract concerns that would prevent us from committing.

SLA/timing constraints: Covanta wants a package by 7/22. If ops/legal can target internal drafts by 7/14 (legal) and 7/18 (ops artifacts), we can assemble and send the bundle with a one-page MAP for Covanta procurement.

I'll coordinate the MAP and the DocuSign envelope once we have the draft DPA. Thanks — please reply with confirmations and rough ETA for your pieces.

—David

David / team — thanks for the quick response and the checklist. That approach works for us. A few clarifying notes from procurement/legal: 

- We will need the explicit clause in the redline DPA and an operational reference (i.e., exact artifact name in the evidence pack) so procurement can sign off without further iterations.
- Subprocessor list should indicate whether each subprocessor has access to live inference payloads, logs, or only to aggregated telemetry. A short table is fine.
- For KMS residency, we need a technical contact for a short call to validate the configuration once you provide the guide.

I'm attaching a redline of the DPA that highlights the no-train ask from our counsel (dpa_redline_covanta_v1.pdf). We'll stand up an internal call next week for the KMS walkthrough once you send the configuration guide.

If you can get the draft DPA to us by 2025-07-14 and the ops artifacts by 2025-07-18, procurement will target sign-off on 2025-07-24. Thanks — appreciate the quick coordination.

Best,
Ellen
